article_notes: Four splenectomised dogs experimentally infected with B. gibsoni (PCR confirmed) and treated with diminazene and then clindamycin, metronidazole and doxycycline; case-by-case serial description. The only statistics are within-dog Pearson correlations of PLT and of CRP with PCV during the recovery phase after starting combination therapy (Figs 2 and 3). These are serial changes during treatment (treatment response), not a comparison between severity or outcome groups, and the coefficients are printed only in the figures; not extracted (see not_extracted). Dog 3 relapsed and was euthanised, but no marker is compared between it and the others. Dog 4 showed no clinical abnormality until splenectomy (n=1, descriptive).

not_extracted.what: Within-dog correlation of platelet count with PCV during the recovery phase (significant in 2 of 4 dogs)
not_extracted.note: Serial correlation during treatment in single dogs (treatment response); r and P values only in Fig. 2. Would not be a severity association even with numbers.

not_extracted.what: Within-dog inverse correlation of plasma CRP with PCV during the recovery phase (significant in all 4 dogs)
not_extracted.note: Serial correlation during treatment in single dogs (treatment response); r and P values only in Fig. 3. Would not be a severity association even with numbers.
